author: cli
text:
Re-read at 0.57.2. All comments verified against the body and still exact: the MRO tier, the annotated-receiver tier ('ground truth beats guessing'), and the confidence ordering are untouched.

What changed here: the loop now lifts TWO facts off each RawEdge - self._via_attr as before, and self._bare, new. They answer different questions and the rules below consume them separately: via_attr feeds 'an attribute call is not a module-level function', bare feeds 'a bare call spelling a language builtin is the builtin'. Reusing one for both cost rich and sqlalchemy their corpus floors before the network lane caught it.

The refusal reason 'builtin-call' joins the existing set; it is a REFUSAL, so per 0.57.1 it must never be counted as a gap in the map by anything reporting coverage.
